description: Stage 4y dedicated cases: clause-level statements in a switch (`case 1: f();` - no braces). The switch case-block brace gets a catalog holding ONLY CaseClauseStatementPossibleShape (never the block-body catalog: expression/variable candidates would swallow `case <expr>:` and throw SourceRange is not set, the Stage 4p failure). The candidate accepts only at the first code unit after a clause colon (or after a previous clause statement) and builds a ShellStatementFamily shell (ScanRoot end); StatementBuilder.BuildCaseBlock collects the built statement shapes into the CaseClauseShape. Each case asserts: (1) shell-path XML == legacy-path XML byte for byte; (2) AST node-for-node == ts.createSourceFile; (3) two parses give identical XML; (4) no shape/CatalogGuide leak in XML; (5) no file-level fallback. Takeover counters (SwitchCaseClauseMountCount / SwitchCaseClauseShellCount / BlockBodyStatementCount) are asserted by tests/statement-possible/s4y-case-clause-takeover.mjs and recorded in HANDOFF-s4y.md. The trap group is the safety gate: case bodies with braces, ternary case expressions, object literals, labels, nested switch, empty switch.

stage4y.stage: Stage 4y (switch clause-level statements taken over; block-level class shell behind a default-off flag)
stage4y.description: Clause-level statements (call, two statements in one clause, two clauses, default, arithmetic case expression, ternary case expression, if with a body, empty statement, let, no trailing semicolon, block-only clause, mixed clause forms, nested switch, empty switch) plus the trap group (object literal with a colon, label statement, object method containing a switch, plain switch case body).
